worldcombat.skill.machpunch.summary: Stand still and send the fist across the gap: a punch too fast for sound to follow, off the mark instantly and without moving the user. It only connects once you are already within arm's reach; the fist arrives first and the sonic boom follows. The heavy form winds up a beat for a harder blow.
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.use.0: The fastest jab once you are at point-blank range
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.use.1: Finish a weakened target without giving up your position
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.use.2: Slip one more hit in right after another move
The punch deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block reach and a %3$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
A hit shoves the target about %1$s blocks along the punch and bursts a sonic ring about %2$s blocks across at the contact point.
which also sets the density of the effect.
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.heavy.on: Heavy form: wind up one beat (+2 ticks preparation) for 20% more power, 25% more shove and 6% more reach, with a longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.heavy.off: Snap form: it fires the moment it commits, with no wind-up and lighter power and cooldown, purely for the speed.
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.growth.0: At level %1$s the punch rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.growth.1: At level %1$s the punch rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.preference.h: On: 20% more power, 25% more shove and 6% more reach, at the cost of a one-beat wind-up (+2 ticks preparation), 2 ticks more recovery and 6 more cooldown. Off: an instant snap punch with no wind-up and lighter power and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.machpunch.preference.a: It only counts targets within this distance; the punch does not move the user and has the shortest reach, so larger values just mean walking in first.
